text: Somewhere in this pipe, a rust flake is heading for your machine.
Standing in its way is this.
Water enters here, and is forced into a stainless steel screen.
Rust, scale, and sand do not.
They're trapped inside the screen, and settle at the bottom of the Y, out of the flow.
caption: They're trapped inside the screen, and settle at the bottom of the Y, out of the flow.

text: But the screen keeps filling up.
The pressure difference across the strainer climbs. Flow slows down. And everything downstream starts to starve.
The debris is blasted out, without taking the strainer apart.
